reason: I'd probably start the trial like I do with every tool, but three days isn't enough to see a single booked call, and with no results published I'd cancel before day 4 rather than get billed $147 on faith. Cold DM tools are everywhere and most of them are mush.
objection: There are no reviews or case studies, so how do I know it books calls? Seven founding seats taken tells me nothing, and I'm risking my own Instagram account on the extension.
would_change_my_mind: Real booked-call numbers from named agency owners, or a trial long enough (a week or two) to see replies from my own niche before the card is charged.
